scope.name: Primitive / Asset Realization
in_scope: surface explicit FGA-03 missing or partial reusable-primitive coverage demand from the live Fashion Design Engine without inventing hidden coverage
route approved garment primitive/asset demand into existing governed PAPT/asset-production capability rather than defining a second production authority
support deterministic provider-off reusable primitive realization where existing local production capability is sufficient
require explicit user approval before any optional generative or paid-provider realization path and preserve provider/source provenance
register realized outputs back against the exact FGA-03 demand/topology/view/component identity so FDE-03 preview can move from semantic fallback toward reusable asset coverage
fail closed for unsupported topology, invalid production output, missing rights/provenance or unavailable provider
focused cross-platform tests for demand routing, approval boundary, provenance, reusable registration, preview coverage refresh and no silent provider execution
out_of_scope: new garment semantics, fit rules or a second asset-production authority
automatic hidden-detail completion from clothing photos
unapproved paid-provider execution or unbounded generative rendering
Oaran fashion houses, designers, eras or cultural style catalogs
Mall, marketplace, commerce, public sharing or creator monetization
equipment ownership/stats, anatomy or mechanics mutation
